**What you need to travel internationally (U.S. citizen)** | Category | Why it’s needed | What to bring / obtain | |----------|----------------|------------------------| | **Valid U.S. passport** | The primary travel document accepted by virtually every country. | • Original passport (once issued).
• If you don’t have one yet, follow the “first‑time passport” checklist below. | | **Proof of U.S. citizenship** (only for first‑time applicants) | The acceptance facility must verify you are a U.S. citizen before issuing a passport. | • **Certificate of Naturalization** – original **and** a clear black‑and‑white photocopy [[concepts/required_documents]]. | | **Government‑issued photo ID** | Used by the acceptance agent to confirm your identity. | • Driver’s license or state ID – original **and** front‑and‑back photocopy [[concepts/required_documents]]. | | **Completed passport application** | Official form for first‑time applicants. | • **DS‑11 form** – fill it out but **do not sign** until the acceptance agent tells you to [[concepts/required_documents]][[entities/ds_11_form]]. | | **Passport photo** | Must meet strict standards. | • One 2 × 2 in (51 × 51 mm) color photo that follows the [[concepts/passport_photo_requirements]] (plain white background, no glasses, proper lighting). | | **Fee payment** | Covers State Department processing and acceptance‑facility service. | • Check or money order for the State Department fee.

• Emergency contact information. *(These items are standard travel practice; the wiki does not contain a dedicated guide for them.)* | ### Quick “first‑time passport” checklist 1. **Certificate of Naturalization** – original + copy. 2. **Government‑issued photo ID** – original + copy. 3. **DS‑11 form** – completed, unsigned. 4. **One compliant passport photo**. 5. **Payment** (check/money order + facility fee). Take all originals and photocopies to a **U.S. Passport Acceptance Facility**; the agent will verify, sign the DS‑11, and forward the packet to the **U.S. State Department** for processing [[entities/us_passport_acceptance_facility]][[entities/us_state_department]]. *Standard processing: 6–8 weeks; plan to apply at least 2 months before your departure.
